svg.title: Sisukas authentication data model
svg.desc: The user table's id is the canonical Sisukas identity. One user has zero or more account rows and zero or more session rows. account has a unique (provider_id, account_id) pair enforced by account_provider_identity_unique from migration 0006. A magic-link user may have no account rows. verification rows are transient and reference no user. plans, favourites and course_grades reference user.id; calendar_hidden_groups and calendar_occurrence_overrides reference a plan, so Calendar ownership is indirect through plans.
svg.text: not an email or provider ID
A magic-link user may have zero
account rows and still sign in.
not domain ownership: it adds an
account row for the existing user.id.
